title: BrightSpire Capital Announces $0.16 Per Share Dividend for Third Quarter 2026
summary: NEW YORK, September 14, 2026--BrightSpire Capital, Inc. (NYSE: BRSP) ("BrightSpire Capital" or the "Company") today announced that the Company’s Board of Directors has declared a dividend of $0.16 per share of Class A common stock for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The dividend is payable on October 14, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026.
